name: Combat Hit Rules
description: Within 10 studs, attacks are guaranteed to hit. Beyond 10 studs, real 3D distance including height is used. Attacks only hit targets within a ±20° forward attack cone, and large height differences cause attacks to miss.
source: Official Discord big-updates tab and combat-system infographic

name: Race Reroll Odds
description: Race Reroll odds were normalized to 33.33% per race in the July 28, 2026 patch.

name: Item Trade Status
description: Every item displays whether it is Bound, Tradeable, or Free, indicating whether it can be traded or given away.

name: World Loot Unlock
description: World loot unlocks after completing Working the Land.

name: Monster Elemental Attributes
description: Monsters have elemental attributes as part of the elemental combat system.

name: HP/MP Regeneration Formula
description: Total Regen = Base Regen + Bonus Regen. Bonus Regen equals 0.2% of Max HP/MP and is capped at 3% of Max HP/MP. Regeneration runs at 50% in combat, 100% out of combat, and 150% while sitting.

name: Identify System
description: Magnifying Glasses can identify Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, Upper Headgear, Middle Headgear, and Lower Headgear. Magnifying Glasses are dropped by Lycaros.

name: Gathering Macro Rules
description: Macros for woodcutting and mining are currently allowed. Auto-combat or auto-mob macros are prohibited and treated as rule violations.

name: Greenhouse
description: Craftable at the Workbench. Each plot normally supports 1 Greenhouse; the Season 1 Premium Pass grants one additional permanent Greenhouse slot.
source: Official Discord announcements by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-05

name: Additional Quick Slots
description: Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2.

name: Skill VFX Filter
description: Graphics setting controlling whose skill effects are displayed. Options: Self, Party, Everyone.

name: World Motion
description: Graphics toggle that can reduce environmental movement for a smoother, less distracting experience.
